item.title: 🔍 Claude has found the culprit
item.description:
Degraded functionality for Claude Cowork on Windows

Impact: minor · Status: identified · Affects: Claude Cowork · Opened: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 15:54:10 +0000

A Windows update released September 8 has caused Claude Cowork on Windows is unable to run local commands on your PC, because its workspace can no longer reach your computer’s drive. For most users, chat and reading or editing files still work. We have identified the cause as a change in Windows; Microsoft has developed a fix and is working on releasing it. There’s no in-app workaround yet, and restarting or reinstalling won’t help. We’ll post an update when we have more to share.

Claude status page

Some users are unable to publish apps with an external DATABASE_URL error

Impact: minor · Status: monitoring · Opened: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 18:41:09 +0000

[Monitoring] Production data is confirmed to be safe after a configuration error during deploys that impacted users on September 1st, 2026. The issue has been resolved going forward and we are working on a fix to restore impacted projects. If your project was impacted by this error please reach out to support.
